title: alphacode A1 research and design decisions
implementationUpdate: 2026-11-09: terminal and Web use React; historical research below is not the current stack. See repository and application READMEs for current dependencies and commands.
currentScope: P0 terminal application only. No public SDK, JSONL or server protocol. Earlier A1 API proposal withdrawn; app server will be planned separately.
scope: Public documentation plus existing Alpha source; no claim about private Claude Code implementation. No star counts or unverified package release versions.

projects.name: Codex
projects.fact: Official documentation separates a reusable harness from CLI, SDK and app-server integration surfaces; CLI includes noninteractive structured output.
projects.adopt: One execution engine, terminal application built on existing Alpha capabilities; future server protocol designed separately.
projects.defer: Server/RPC/daemon until there is an actual remote client requirement.

projects.name: Claude Code
projects.fact: Public docs describe model/tool/context execution, action-specific permission prompts and a noninteractive CLI entry.
projects.adopt: Show exact commands and directories at approval time, visible tool outcomes and real exit codes.
projects.defer: Complex permission DSL, auto classifiers, checkpoint and other capabilities not supplied by current Alpha packages.

projects.name: Pi
projects.fact: Terminal layout includes transcript, editor and footer; UI guidance prioritizes existing dialogs/widgets and a single renderer.
projects.adopt: Small composable UI regions, progressive tool details, use existing Alpha extension contracts.
projects.defer: Pi runtime/TUI adoption, new universal plugin registry and unimplemented steering or branching.

runtime.preferred: single-process Node, conditional on A0 validation
runtime.solidCompile: babel-preset-solid universal transform targeting @opentui/solid; published Solid client runtime resolution
